out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED OPEN DRINKING CONTAINER ABOVE PREP SURFACE.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.PIC REMOVED THE DEINK FROM THE KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: bean sprouts
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC LABELED BEAN SPROUTS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: observed newspaper covering chopped herbs in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC DISCARDED HERBS AND NEWSPAPER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed rice scoops stored in room temperature water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC DUMPED OUT WATER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the cook line being used to drain water from cooking
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC ON PROPER USE OF THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The chlorine concentration in the chemical dish machine was observed at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: observed soup in the walk in cooler at 45F. PIC said the soup was put in the walk in the night before
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED SOUP.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties: OBSERVED MULTIPLE AREAS THAT FOOD EMPLOYEES NEED TRAINING ON INCLUDING: COOLING METHODS COOLING PROCESS COLD HOLDING, HOT HOLDING DATE MARKING HANDWASHING GLOVE CHANGING SANITIZING
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. THE PIC MUST TRAIN ALL FOOD EMPLOYEES IN FOOD SAFETY WITH EMPHASIS ON THE ABOVE FACTORS. EHS TO ATTACH DOCUMENTS TO AID IN TRAINING. ENSURE TRAINING TAKES PLACE BEFORE THE THREE DAY FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A certified food manager with a valid credential from a nationally recognized exam is required to be present during all hours of operation. CDI: CFM CAME IN THE MIDDLE OF INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils: OBSERVED AN OPEN COFFEE IN A WATER GLASS AND TEA IN AN OPEN TO GO CONTAINER ON THE SHELVES ABOVE PREP AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. ENSURE ALL DRINKS IN KITCHEN AREAS ARE COVERED AND CONSUMED THROUGH A STRAW. CEASE DRINKING FROM OPEN CONTAINERS IN KITCHEN AREAS. ENSURE TRAINING TAKES PLACE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands: OBSERVED FOOD WORKER WITH GLOVED HANDS MOVE FROM PREPPING RAW FOODS TO GOING OUTSIDE BACK TO PREPPING RAW FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI: EHS INTERVENED AND FOOD WORKER REMOVED SOILED GLOVES AND WASHED HIS HANDS. EHS RE-EDUCATED FOOD WORKER ON HANDWASHING AND GLOVE WEARING PROCEDURE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEES GO TO THE FOOD PREP SINK TO WASH HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: EHS INTERVENED AND FOOD WORKER WASHED HANDS IN HANDWASHING SINK. FOOD WORKER RE-EDUCATED. PHO FACTORY (Inspection Date: 05/20/2025) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS IN WALK-IN COOLER STORED ABOVE RAW VEGETABLES. OBSERVED RAW PORK MIX ABOVE VEGETABLES IN WALK-IN COOLER
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EGGS AND RAW PORK MUST BE STORED BELOW PRODUCE OR RTE ITEMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH COOKING TEMPERATURE. REARRANGE WALK-IN ACCORDINGLY. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED FOOD WORKER WASHING KNIVES AND CUTTING BOARD IN PREP SINK AFTER PREPPING RAW MEAT. FOOD WORKER WAS NOT AWARE ITEMS NEEDED TO BE SANITIZED.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: FOOD WORKER PUT KNIVES AND CUTTING BOARD IN DISHMACHINE. FOOD WORKER RE-EDUCATED ON SANITIZATION PRACTICES. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED 3.5 POTS OF PHO BROTH IN WALK-IN WITH TEMPERATURES RANGING FROM 49F-53F. MANAGER STATED THEY WERE PLACED IN WALK- IN TO COOL THE NIGHT BEFORE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: ALL POTS OF PHO BROTH DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION. TRAINING MUST TAKE PLACE TO EDUCATE FOOD WORKERS ON PROPER COOLING. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SPRING ROLLS ON COUNTER AT 92F-97F AND PHO NOODLES ON COUNTER AT 101F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BOTH SPRING ROLLS AND COOKED PHO NOODLES MOVED TO FREEZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION. ENSURE FURTHER COMPLIANCE BEFORE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PHO FACTORY (Inspection Date: 05/20/2025) Page 2 of 6

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -WALK-IN COOLER: BEAN SPROUTS 45F, SPRING ROLLS 46F, COMMERCIALLY PACKAGED TOFU 45-48F, WASHED LETTUCE 45F -COUNTER: BEAN SPROUTS WITH WATER 67F -COCA-COLA COOLER (DINING AREA): HALF AND HALF AT 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS FOOD IN WALK-IN COOLER THROWN AWAY DURING INSPECTION. HALF AND HALF DISPOSED OF. BEAN SPROUTS ON COUNTER COOLED DOWN TO 42F WITH ADDED ICE. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO DATE MARKING IN ESTABLISHMENT FOR TCS FOODS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO COOKED MEATS, PHO BROTH, COOKED NOODLES, AND SPRING ROLLS.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. ENSURE PROPER DATE MARKING ON TCS ITEMS HELD IN RESTAURANT FOR OVER 24HRS. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED HOT FOODS SUCH AS PHO BROTH AND COOKED NOODLES AND SPRING ROLLS NOT BEING COOLED EFFECTIVELY.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. STAFF INSTRUCTED TO PURCHASE ICE WANDS, UTILIZE WALK-IN FREEZER, PURCHASE SHALLOW SHEET PANS TO COOL HOT FOODS RAPIDLY. SEE FACT SHEETS ATTACHED TO EMAIL. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of calibration in the range of use. OBSERVED FOOD THERMOMETER REGISTERING 60F IN THE ICE WATER BATH.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. EITHER CALIBRATE THERMOMETER OR REPLACE IT WITH A PROPERLY WORKING THERMOMETER IN WHICH YOU CALIBRATE REGULARLY IN AN ICE WATER BATH TO 32F. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SPICES, SQUEEZE BOTTLES, ETC UNLABELED IN WORKING CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. ENSURE ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF FOOD ARE LABELED WITH THE COMMON NAME OF THE FOOD. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the SCREEN DOOR IN KITCHEN. OBSERVED THE SCREEN DOOR IN KITCHEN TO HAVE A VERY WIDE GAP AT THE TOP AND GAPS AROUND THE BOTTOM AND LEFT SIDE. OBSERVED THE FRONT DOOR TO BE OPEN WHEN EHS ARRIVED TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. DOOR MUST BE PROPERLY FITTED TO THE DOORFRAME. FRONT DOOR MUST BE KEPT CLOSED. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. OBSERVED SEVERAL LIMES AND A BOTTLED DRINK WITHIN THE ICE MACHINE . WHEN ASKED, PIC STATED THE ICE IS USED FOR DRINKS FOR PATRONS.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. CEASE USING THIS ICE FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN FOR FOOD. STORE FOOD ITEMS IN A COOLER. DISPOSE OF ALL ICE AND DO NOT SERVE TO PATRONS AS IT IS CONTAMINATED. RE-EDUCATE EMPLOYEES ON FOOD CONTAMINATION. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE AMOUNTS OF FOOD IN THE WALK-IN COOLER AND FREEZER ON THE FLOOR IN CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ALL FOOD MUST BE 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR. DO NOT USE MILK CRATES OR PRODUCE CRATES TO LIFT THE FOOD. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: OBSERVED TWO PIECES OF MOLDY CARDBOARD ON TOP OF FRESH VEGETABLES IN WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. CDI: CARDBOARD THROWN AWAY AT TIME OF INSPECTION. CEASE USING CARDBOARD TO COVER FOOD. THROW THESE AWAY. WASH VEGETABLES BEFORE USE. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP. PHO FACTORY (Inspection Date: 05/20/2025) Page 5 of 6

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER ROLLING SPRING ROLLS WITHOUT HAIR RESTRAINTS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. CDI: FOOD WORKER PUT ON HAT DURING INSPECTION. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: Wiping cloths improperly stored between use, not in chemical sanitizing solution, in the following locations: OBSERVED HEAVILY SOILED DRY WIPING CLOTHS ON SURFACES.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily. CLEAN, LAUNDERED, DRY WIPING CLOTHS CAN BE KEPT ON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES. WET WIPING CLOTHES MUST BE STORED IN A SANITIZER SOLUTION OF 50-200PPM OF CHLORINE. DO NOT USE HEAVILY SOILED WIPING CLOTHS AS THEY WILL NOT CLEAN. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED MULTIPLE UTENSILS IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER AT THE RICE COOKER. OBSERVED PLASTIC TAKE HOME CONTAINERS USED TO DISPENSE BULK FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: UTENSILS REMOVED FROM WATER, WATER DUMPED, UTENSILS WERE RUN THROUGH DISHWASHER. ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE FOOD SCOOPS DESIGNED WITH HANDLES; DO NOT USE TAKE HOME CONTAINERS TO SCOOP BULK FOODS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. PHO FACTORY (Inspection Date: 05/20/2025) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for peanut butter, dry shallots, dry seasonings, and sriracha bottles were observed reused for other foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE WALK-IN COOLER MEASURED 44F. OBSERVED THE COCA COLA COOLER IN THE DINING AREA TO BE 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. BOTH UNITS MUST BE REPAIRED SO THAT THEY ARE MAINTAINING AN INTERNAL TEMPERATURE OF 34F-38F SO THEY CAN HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: PRODUCE CRATES found used for the following purpose(s): 1) STORAGE OF OTHER FOODS, 2) STORAGE OF EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE ALL PRODUCE CRATES AND REPLACE WITH NSF APPROVED BINS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED HEAVY DEBRIS AND GRIME ALONG THE COOKLINE, FLOOR OF WALK-IN COOLER, SHELVING UNITS, EXTERIORS OF BULK FOOD BINS, STORAGE UNITS UNDER WORK TABLES, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. THE ABOVE AREAS MUST BE CLEANED TO REMOVE GRIME AND DEBRIS. BEGIN CLEANING AT A HIGHER FREQUENCY. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to the KITCHEN COOK LINE hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE A SMALL TRASH CAN UNDER THE KITCHEN HAND SINK BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use: OBSERVED MOPS WITH HEADS DOWN IN BACK AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. MOPS MUST BE STORED UPRIGHT TO DRAIN PROPERLY. ENSURE COMPLIANCE BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP.
